The programmes integrates advanced monitoring systems and real-time data analysis to enable timely responses to information threats and to support evidence-based editorial decision-making. Consistent with OECD recommendations on safeguarding democratic processes and strengthening resilience against disinformation, the programmes emphasize the importance of monitoring emerging information threats and ensuring the timely availability of accurate, relevant information for citizens, particularly those most vulnerable to manipulation. Accessible, high-quality intelligence on the information environment helps independent media address information gaps that can otherwise be exploited by malign actors.
